for a **two-set cover** the Čech Euler characteristic needs no exact sequence at all:

`χ(D) = dim 𝒞⁰(D) − dim 𝒞¹(D)` where `𝒞⁰(D) = Γ(U₀,𝒪(D)) ⊕ Γ(U₁,𝒪(D))`,

**THE RULE (this is the durable part).** Before grinding a certificate/finiteness hypothesis in this project, check what the actual CONSUMER's predicate is. The project has both a global notion (`IsCertified`, over the whole chart ring $R_Z$) and a Zariski-local one (`IsLocallyCertified`, `DivisorFamilyZar.lean:71`), and **every** downstream interface was built on the local one: `divRepPullAt` (`DivRepAffKit.lean`), `DivRepAffinePullback.pull`, `divRepClassifyZar` (`DivRepClassifyZar.lean:244`) all take `DivFamZar`, never `IsCertified` over $R$.

- `exists_basicOpen_supportTube` / `exists_notMem_supportLocus_subset_of_fibre` — the support tube refined to the basic-open (Away) shape the gate consumes.

For where the campaign gate actually sits, read `I-0365` (it is L8, local surjectivity, not U2). For the field-size boundary of the R1 escape, read `I-0346`.
==========I-0365==========
WHERE THE DD-R GATE ACTUALLY BITES: NOT U2, NOT 'the certificate for the universal family' -- IT IS L8, LOCAL SURJECTIVITY. Established run 0048 round 5 by a seven-front recon with an adversarial refuter per front; the refuter on the 'single gate' front overturned the recon on exactly this point, and I re-verified it at source.

THE OLD FRAMING, which several roadmap rows and worksheets still use: 'the divrep tail is
independent of the certificate; the certificate only gates U2'. That is FALSE, and the reason is
structural rather than a failed proof.

WHAT IS TRUE.
 * DivFamZar C S pi g is BY DEFINITION a quotient of LOCALLY CERTIFIED divisor families
   (DivisorFamilyZar.lean:224,:235). Certificates are not consumed by the tail -- they come with
   the object.
 * So on the consuming side certificates are free, and DivFamZar.exists_certChartCover
   (DivRepClassifyZarKit.lean:433) is a landed THEOREM that produces a certified representative
   Zariski-locally from the vehicle itself. It is unfolded by every keystone of the classifier:
   DivRepClassifyZar.lean:128 (exists_isDivRepClassify), :176 (isDivRepClassify_unique),
   :230 (exists_overHom_isDivRepClassify), DivRepClassifyZarSep.lean:361 and :363

   (G : CertifiedDivisorFamily C T pi g) in its body at :95-97 -- a hypothesis, so scarcity of
   certificates makes the predicate EASIER, not harder.

C pi g is a PROPER SUBFUNCTOR of 'degree-g relative divisors'. Representing it is not the problem
-- the whole L9-L13 tail does that honestly, over a section variable, and round 5 nearly finished

Abel map out of it is not Zariski-locally surjective, because the classes whose only witnesses
are the invisible divisors are not hit. That is L8, the
Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective (Sigma.desc f) input of pic0RepresentableByOfCharts

    surjectivity onto Pic^0 from a subfunctor that misses classes is FALSE, not merely unproved,
